question_content: Summarize the core combat mechanics (or “N/A” if not mentioned).
synthesis_answer:
- Turn-based, GBF-like combat; largely number checks with minimal strategy. [46828590, 46819524, 46958102, 46823148]
- Auto-battle unlocks early; exploration and fights can be fully automated. [46928089, 46834055, 46834000]
- Skill axis lets you script actions; but setup UI lacks descriptions. [46832432, 46843571]
- Auto AI wastes heals/buffs on turn one; poor timing logic. [46834000, 46837066, 46841939]
- Skill axis settings often reset or disappear; some skills can’t be added. [46958908, 46925128]
- Requests for separate ultimate toggle; teammates overstack ultimates. [46956348, 46828590]
- Ultimate chains exist but effects are unexplained. [46928089, 46834000]
- Buff/status terminology unclear; many icons without in-battle explanations. [46903937, 46832432, 46828079]
- Long skill cooldowns (7–8 turns); healing caps too low for AoE. [46846433, 46834000, 46928089]
- Elemental mono-teams rewarded; four attributes with synergy/affinity. [46928089, 46860366, 46832540]
- Party uses 4 active plus 2 reserves; pets and weapons add skills/stats. [46928089, 46832540, 46834055]
- Ten-slot weapon grid drives stats; slot rules and effects are confusing. [46832540, 46928613, 46841939]
- Boss HP is huge; battles often take several minutes or longer. [46834000, 46863198, 46841939, 46955938]
- No battle speedup or sweeps; only skip current turn. [46934951, 46834733, 46860752]
- Tower/climb auto-battles are slow; ~4 minutes per floor. [46863198, 46832432]
- Auto sometimes defaults to normal attacks in co-op. [46843571, 46841939]
- Frequent combat bugs: freezes, black screens, post-battle softlocks. [46834000, 46860752, 46903937]
- Controls hinder combat flow: fixed central joystick in vertical orientation. [46934951, 46842449]
- Balance concerns: fire outdamages earth; SR–SSR damage gap is huge. [46947048, 46825708]
- Suspected damage caps; multi-hit skills likely superior. [46832540]
- Enemies feel basic; boss attacks lack telegraph and damage feedback. [46903937]
- Co-op rewards hinge on contribution/MVP; non-drops feel punishing. [46860366, 46841939]
